title: A different jerky
body:
My first order included bags of Original, Teriyaki, and Salt and Pepper.  

 I am a mushroom lover. The weekly list of food I prepare myself shows that. But, I was a bit embarrassed to acknowledge that I hadn’t thought ahead that the flavor of a mushroom jerky would be a little “different“. 

 It is. And, I’ve grown to enjoy it. It’s just the first taste is something to be prepared for. 

 On the other hand, the texture is very satisfying from the first bite. A true plant-based jerky. 

 My one disappointment is that, to my taste buds, the different flavors are not as distinct from each other as I expected or would wish for. It could be my taste buds. But, I can barely discern a black pepper note in the Salt & Pepper. And, I imagined it with some anticipation—mushrooms with black pepper! What could be better? I’ve enjoyed dishes featuring that flavor combo in restaurants and at home. Similarly, I detect only a very faint, if not imagined, reference to the sweet-salty-tangy-umami flavor profile that “Teriyaki” promises. 

 Is there a way to make more defined flavor statements with your jerkies? 

 I imagine I will buy more. I love having a plant based treat with such a satisfying jerky texture/mouth feel. But, I would probably rush out to buy more if the flavors were a bit more forward.
